## Features\
\
Bookmakers\
\
The Odds API covers odds from several global bookmakers including\
\
\
- **US Bookmakers**\
\
DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, Bovada, MyBookie.ag and more\
\
- **UK Bookmakers**\
\
Unibet, William Hill, Ladbrokes, Betfair, Bet Victor, Paddy Power and more\
\
- **EU Bookmakers**\
\
1xBet, Pinnacle, Betfair, Unibet and more\
\
- **Aussie Bookmakers**\
\
Sportsbet, TAB, Neds, Ladbrokes, Betfair, Unibet and more\
\
\
See the [full list of bookmakers →](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/bookmaker-apis.html)\
\
Sports\
\
The Odds API provides odds data for several in-season sports\
\
- **Football odds data**   NFL, College Football (NCAA), CFL, Aussie Rules (AFL) and more\
- **Soccer odds data**   EPL, EFL Championship, German Bundesliga, UEFA Europa & Champions Leagues, Italian Serie A, Spanish La Liga, Campeonato Brasileiro Série A, French Ligue 1 and much more\
- **Basketball odds data**   NBA, US College Basketball (NCAA), WNBA, Euroleague and more\
- **Baseball odds data**   MLB, MiLB, KBO, NPB\
- **Ice hockey odds data**   NHL, AHL, SHL, HockeyAllsvenskan, Liiga, Mestis\
- **Cricket odds data**   Test matches, IPL, Big Bash and more\
- **Rugby league odds data**   Aussie NRL\
- **Golf odds data**   Masters Tournament, PGA Championship, US Open, The Open Championship\
- **Tennis odds data**   Grand Slams, ATP 1000, WTA 1000 and more\
- **Politics odds data**   Next US President odds\
- **And more**\
\
See the [full list of sports →](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/sports-apis.html)\
\
Betting Markets\
\
The Odds API offers odds data for the following betting markets\
\
\
- **head-to-head (moneyline) odds**\
- **point spreads (handicap) odds**\
- **totals (over/under) odds**\
- **outrights (futures) odds** for selected competitions\
- **And more** Player props, alternate spreads and totals, and other markets are now available for selected sports and bookmakers, with more on the way\
\
[More info on betting markets →](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/betting-markets.html)\
\
Update Intervals\
\
The Odds API delivers recent odds for in-play and upcoming sports events from several bookmakers.\
\
[More info on update intervals →](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/update-intervals.html)\
\
Format\
\
The Odds API feed is in JSON format, and is also available as add-ons for [Google Sheets](https://the-odds-api.com/features/spreadsheets.html) and [Excel](https://the-odds-api.com/features/excel.html)\
\
The Odds API feed supports decimal and American odds formats.\
\
\
## Why The Odds API\
\
Easy Integration\
\
The Odds API is simple & well-documented, allowing for fast, low-cost integration\
\
\
Coverage & Features\
\
We cover over 70 sports and over 40 bookmakers, and we continue to expand our offering\
\
Here for the long run\
\
We've been operating since 2017, based out of Melbourne, Australia\
\
## FAQs\
\
Q What happens when I subscribe?\
\
You will receive an email containing your API key and links to help you get started.\
\
Q When am I billed?\
\
For paid plans, billing happens straight away.\
Payment then happens automatically each month thereafter, on the same day of the month that the subscription started.\
\
\
For example if the first payment happens on the 1st of the month, you will be charged on the 1st for subsequent months.\
\
Q How can I cancel?\
\
You can cancel your subscription at any time using [this form](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/cancel.html) or in the [accounts portal](https://dash.the-odds-api.com/).\
\
\
Your subscription will automatically cancel before the next billing cycle.\
\
Q What is a request?\
\
A single request returns live and upcoming games for a given **sport**, betting **market**, and bookmaker **region**. Each game includes a start time, participants, and bookmaker odds for the specified region.\
\
\
**Example**: if you request odds for basketball NBA, from US-region bookmakers, and moneyline betting markets, the API will return live and upcoming NBA games, showing moneyline odds from US bookmakers. This will count as 1 request from your plan's usage quota.\
\
\
Q How frequently are odds updated?\
\
More info on odds update intervals can be [found here](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/update-intervals.html).\
\
Q How do I upgrade or downgrade a subscription?\
\
More info on upgrading or downgrading your subscription can be [found here](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/upgrade-downgrade-cancel-a-subscription.html).\
\
[More FAQs →](https://the-odds-api.com/manage/faqs.html)\
\
## More from The Odds API\
\
- [**Historical Sports Odds API**](https://the-odds-api.com/historical-odds-data/) Historical snapshots of sports odds data back to 2020.\
- [**Scores & Results API**](https://the-odds-api.com/liveapi/guides/v4/#get-scores) Game scores and results in a simple API.\
- [**Odds Widget for Websites**](https://the-odds-api.com/widget/) Bring bookmaker odds into your website with a simple HTML tag. Monetize with your own affiliate links.\
- **[Excel](https://the-odds-api.com/features/excel.html) and [Google Sheets](https://the-odds-api.com/features/spreadsheets.html) Add-ons** Get odds data in spreadsheets at the click of a button.\
- **[Player Props Odds](https://the-odds-api.com/sports-odds-data/betting-markets.html#player-props-api-markets)** Player props odds are now available in the API for selected US sports and bookmakers, with more on the way.\
\
